_notes.fast_search: production ships visual-tier search OFF; receipts are scanned images indexed by the fast/ColPali tier, so retrieval REQUIRES fast_search=true on this dataset. Recorded decision (review #31): dataset-level override, explicit here, worker default stays production-faithful False.
_notes.temperature: evals run at 0 (PLAN 4.2); production settings.json default is 0.7
_notes.local_n_ctx: pinned: .env.example fresh-clone value & shipped-beta ctx; this machine's .env says 65536 and must not leak (PLAN 3)
_notes.rerank: MAGPIE_RERANK kill-switch; production default is ON - this baseline deliberately diverges (owner decision 2026-08-29): the cross-encoder scores visual hits against a constant placeholder (product bug #1), so rerank off = ColQwen's own ranking. false also structurally disables the solo gate (margin is on cross-encoder score scale); solo_margin is pinned 0 here to make gate-off explicit rather than implied
_notes.solo_margin: 0 = gate off (owner decision 2026-08-29, paired with rerank=false above); production default is 2.0
_notes.col_model: auto = this machine resolves (ColQwen needs >=8GB VRAM or >=24GB unified; else ColSmol). Pin colqwen|colsmol for cross-machine comparability; resolved family stamped in run.json; part of the index key
_notes.grounding_guard: Numeral guard (src/answer.py:_apply_grounding_guard): an answer whose EVERY number is absent from the TEXT shown is converted to not_found. ON = production. Measured 2026-09-03 on the all-image custom_dataset_rahul runs: 31 conversions per run, ~two thirds of all false abstentions, because image blocks contribute no text support - a correct figure read off a receipt photo is killed by construction. false = skip the guard (the arm that measures what it costs); the image-aware fix is a separate src change. Pinned as MAGPIE_GROUNDING_GUARD.
_notes.strict_grounding: Whether index-time LLM summaries may count as support for a figure. ON (production) = they do not - a summary is the model's own earlier output and letting it ground a later answer is how a fabrication launders itself into a fact. Pinned as MAGPIE_STRICT_GROUNDING; independent of grounding_guard.
